transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've just been feeling absolutely amazing, like I have this incredible, overflowing energy that I can't even contain! For the past month, my mood has been so incredibly high and euphoric, and I feel like I'm on top of the world. I just have so much vitality and I'm ready to take on everything!
During this month, have you had any hallucinations or beliefs that other people said were not true, even when your mood was not especially high?

No, those things only happen when my mood is super high and I'm feeling this incredible rush of energy. When my mood is normal or stable, I don't experience any of those unusual beliefs or voices at all. It's only when I'm feeling on top of the world like this.
Have these high-energy, euphoric symptoms lasted at least one week, or have they been severe enough to cause major problems like hospitalization?

Oh, absolutely. This incredible energy and high mood have been going on non-stop for about a month now, which is way longer than just a week. It's been so intense and constant that I just haven't been able to slow down at all!
Based on what you've told me, this is most consistent with Bipolar I Disorder with psychotic features because the psychotic symptoms occur only during the manic episodes.

That makes complete sense, Doctor. Those voices and the feeling of being watched only ever happen when I'm in this super high, energetic state. When my mood is normal or stable, none of those strange things happen at all.
